fields.accordionHeading: What is Virtual Care or Virtual Visits?
fields.accordionDescription: Virtual Care provides access to doctors online at no cost. Doctors are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. No appointment is needed. Get the right care, right now, available online or by phone. Click on the Virtual Care Helpful Link. The services offered by Teladoc are also available in person or via telemedicine (if available) through your primary care provider or another Molina network provider.
